# Global Partnership for Education

> > Global Partnership for Education mobilizes $15B in funding to transform education systems and reach 372M children across 96 partner countries through innovative financing, technical assistance, and multi-stakeholder collaboration.

GPE is a multilateral partnership that channels development finance to strengthen education systems in low- and middle-income countries. The organization combines grant funding, technical assistance, knowledge exchange, and advocacy to drive systemic education transformation with focus on equity, quality, and climate resilience.

## Key Topics

- Education systems transformation
- Education financing and innovative instruments
- Girls' education and equity
- GPE 2030 strategic framework
- Partner country engagement
- Technical assistance
- Monitoring and evaluation
- Aid effectiveness and alignment
- Crisis-affected education
- Knowledge and Innovation Exchange (KIX)
- Education Out Loud advocacy fund
- Multiplier and SmartEd financing
- Global education funding
- System capacity building
- Policy dialogue

## Core Mission & Strategy

- [Global Partnership for Education](https://www.globalpartnership.org): GPE homepage: $15B funding goal for 750M children in 96 countries
- [Transforming education](https://www.globalpartnership.org/what-we-do/transforming-education): GPE's approach to education system transformation in partner countries
- [How we work](https://www.globalpartnership.org/how-we-work): GPE's partnership model for education system transformation
- [GPE impact](https://www.globalpartnership.org/results/gpe-impact): GPE impact: 372M children reached 2021-2025 across partner nations

## Funding & Replenishment

- [Replenishment](https://www.globalpartnership.org/funding/replenishment): GPE 2026-2030 replenishment campaign: $15B fundraising initiative
- [How to apply for grants](https://www.globalpartnership.org/funding/how-apply-grants): GPE grant application pathway and Partnership Compact guidelines
- [Innovative financing](https://www.globalpartnership.org/funding/innovative-financing): GPE Multiplier and SmartEd: innovative education financing instruments
- [Grant data](https://www.globalpartnership.org/funding/grant-data): Interactive GPE grant portfolio data 2003-present by country/region
- [Financial reporting](https://www.globalpartnership.org/funding/financial-reporting): GPE donor contributions and transparent financial allocation reporting

## Implementation & Support

- [Technical assistance initiatives](https://www.globalpartnership.org/how-we-work/technical-assistance-initiatives): GPE technical assistance for education system capacity building
- [Monitoring, evaluation and learning](https://www.globalpartnership.org/how-we-work/monitoring-evaluation): GPE's monitoring, evaluation and learning framework for results
- [Alignment and aid effectiveness](https://www.globalpartnership.org/how-we-work/alignment-and-aid-effectiveness): GPE's aid alignment approach for education system transformation

## Knowledge & Advocacy

- [Knowledge and innovation](https://www.globalpartnership.org/what-we-do/knowledge-innovation): GPE Knowledge and Innovation Exchange (KIX) for cross-country collaboration
- [Advocacy and accountability](https://www.globalpartnership.org/what-we-do/advocacy-accountability): Education Out Loud fund: civil society engagement in education policy
